about.body: This is not a bulk catalogue. It is the catalogue of One Piece Shop — your own neighbourhood shop in Gahkuch, two shops combined into one — with its own vintage character. Every coat, jacket, hoodie and carpet is exactly one piece. What you see in the photo is what you will find in the shop. Reserve it in time, or someone else takes it tomorrow.
